W.note: Dark glow field with a staggered assemble, burst and reassemble that loops cleanly from an invisible seam, but it redraws the Figma logo mark itself, which hurts originality.

X.note: Flat spectrum shapes on a soft pastel gradient with a slow, exact periodic loop, though the motion is calm and the composition is sparse with a visible letterbox band on desktop.

Y.note: Varied-easing shapes on a gradient field, with white selection-style handles that reference the Figma editor, and a clean seam and responsive card layout.

Z.note: A literal Figma logo assemble-explode on flat gray, with pieces clipped at the viewBox edge mid-loop and a small velocity kink where the backOut segment starts at the seam.
